_comment: Single source of truth for the cross-service pipeline suites. Key = filename in configurations/woodland/gas/test-data/. Declares ONLY the GAS verdict for each fixture: { gas: 'accept' } or { gas: 'reject', errorContains: '<substring of the 400 body>' }. The invariant 'GAS-accept => every downstream service accepts' is enforced in code (see test/pipeline/README.md), not here: the GAS suite (test/gas) asserts GAS matches this verdict; each downstream suite (test/agreements, and future services) reuses gasAcceptedFixtures from fixtures.js and asserts that service accepts every GAS-accepted fixture. There is deliberately NO per-downstream accept/reject file, so a gap cannot be declared away.
